name: TINKER

paragraph.en-US: Tinkers coax wonders out of scrap, steam and stubbornness. This class exists only to exercise the importer's homebrew path.
Spend 3 Hope to repair a broken object within Close range, or to give an ally a +2 bonus to their next action roll using a tool you built.
Once per rest, mark a Stress to build a temporary tool that lets you make an action roll with a trait of your choice.
When you take a short rest, you can also clear an Armor Slot for an ally.

backgroundQuestions: What did you build that you wish you hadn't?
Who taught you to read a blueprint?
Which of your creations is still out there somewhere?
connections: What did I fix for you that you never asked me to?
Why do you refuse to let me tinker with your gear?
What do we build together on quiet nights?
